name: Monster Manor
source:
A magical mansion, with a more magical persona has fallen into disrepair, and it needs the help of a very special renovator. Can you step inside and find a way to build the bonds between the mansion and its extraordinary residents? Help fix up the rooms and return this once beautiful mansion to its former glory!

[From in-app]
